What to check before buying a robot vacuum

  • Navigation: LiDAR or camera-based mapping can make a big difference to how efficiently the robot covers rooms.
  • Dock features: self-emptying, mop washing and drying add convenience but also cost and take up more space.
  • Floor type: check carpet performance, threshold height and whether mop lifting is supported if you have mixed flooring.
  • Consumables: replacement bags, filters, brushes and mop pads can affect the long-term cost.
  • Exact model number: similarly named models can have different docks, suction ratings and accessories.

eBay UK vs Amazon UK: where should you compare?

eBay UK can be useful for new, refurbished and open-box robot vacuums, particularly where seller feedback and condition details are clearly shown. Amazon UK is useful for checking current new-stock availability, reviews, delivery and returns. We now use model-specific Amazon searches wherever a clear model number is available, rather than sending you to a broad robot-vacuum category page.

How we choose these picks

Our product comparisons use current retailer information, model identification, seller information and practical buying checks. We do not physically test every product featured, so where cleaning performance, obstacle avoidance, battery life or durability matters, we recommend checking independent reviews of the exact model before buying.

Frequently asked questions

Is a self-emptying robot vacuum worth paying more for?

It can be if you want to reduce day-to-day maintenance. The trade-off is a larger dock, extra consumables and usually a higher purchase price.

Should I buy a refurbished robot vacuum?

Refurbished models can offer strong value, but check who refurbished the product, the warranty period, battery condition, included accessories and returns policy.

Do robot vacuums replace a normal vacuum cleaner?

For many homes they are best viewed as a maintenance cleaner between deeper cleans. Performance on stairs, tight corners and heavily soiled areas still varies.
